'''Thekko Longshot''' was a male [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] warrior fighting on the side of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Imperials.
